searchText: The splitting zero attack has been known since 2019 and addressed by https://ethresear.ch/t/fast-verification-of-multiple-bls-signatures/5407 in all libraries used in Ethereum. They are part of the Ethereum BLS test suite: https://github.com/ethereum/bls12-381-tests/blob/master/main.py#L483-L501
